title: Worker source interface atlas
context: Illustrative API contract, not production code. Only the checked-in header signatures are mechanically verified; behavior below is example documentation.

interfaces.name: worker_open
interfaces.summary: Initialize a worker with an explicit capacity.
parameters: capacity [in]: maximum accepted job count in this illustrative contract.
interfaces.returns: Example contract: zero on success, negative on initialization failure.
notes: A declaration is not evidence that an implementation or error path was executed.

interfaces.name: worker_run
interfaces.summary: Run one caller-supplied job with a timeout.
interfaces.signature: int worker_run(const char *job, unsigned int timeout_ms);
interfaces.returns: Example contract: zero on completion, negative on invalid input or timeout.
notes: Timeout does not by itself prove cancellation, rollback or safe recovery.

interfaces.name: worker_close
interfaces.summary: Release the worker after the application has finished using it.
notes: This fixture does not specify concurrent shutdown behavior.

nodes.note: Three declarations belong to the same API component; this is not an execution sequence.
